statement: In holdout texts that end in a closer, signs G100, G760, G142 and G923 (as a set) are the last sign of the middle, immediately before the closer, more often than when each middle's signs are shuffled. Middle = text minus leading openers (plus G2 or G60 right after them) and trailing closers; roles from the frozen rule on all exploration texts; middles of 2+ signs only. Exploration: 94.5% of 145 occurrences last, against 31% shuffled. A heading is not required because requiring one would leave about 12 holdout occurrences, below the project's minimum support of 15 for sign tests; with it, about 38 are expected. Source: results/middle_flow_scouting.md.
